neighborhoods.name: Kingston Buci
neighborhoods.notes: historic core area with conservation elements

property_mix.notable: seaside town with heritage seafront properties and residential inland terraces. Strong Victorian/Edwardian housing stock throughout.

locksmith_relevant: Victorian and Edwardian terraces dominate; period locks and sash windows require specialist knowledge and care.
Coastal location means salt-spray corrosion is common; regular maintenance and marine-grade hardware are essential.
High rental/holiday let turnover in seafront areas creates frequent emergency access and rekeying demand.
